info.name: Gets the configurations of an agent.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: The environment's key.

params.name: agentKey
params.description: The agent's key.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include. Allowed values: systemConfigurations, settings, timers, integrations, libraries.

params.name: showBinaryValues
params.description: Specifies whether to return the binary values.

items.docs:
Returns the agent configurations for the deployed revision.

API Client needs the **Configuration management > View configurations** permission for the target environment (stage).

info.name: Updates the default system configurations of an environment (stage).

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: The environment's key.

items.docs:
Updates the default system configuration values for an environment. Only the provided elements are changed.

To update configurations, API Client needs the **Configuration management > Edit configurations** permission for the target environment (stage).

To update email configurations, API Client needs the **Configuration management > Manage Email SMTP configuration** permission for the target environment (stage).

Deprecated since 2026-07-08. Use GET /portfolios/v2/environments instead. Note that V2's
EnvironmentsController does not use the in-memory response caching this V1 endpoint has.
This endpoint will be removed on or after 2027-01-08.

The result only shows environments (stages) for which the API Client has **Stage > View stage** permission.
Requires **Portfolio management > Manage stages** permission for environments when changing name only, and **Portfolio management > Manage portfolio** when changing order.

info.name: Retrieves usage data per asset (application, library) for entitlements in a specific environment.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Environment key

params.name: entitlementIds
params.description: Optional comma-separated entitlement IDs. Valid values: applicationObjects, maxComputeReplicas, maxCustomCodeTotalDuration, agentExecutions

params.name: assetKeys
params.description: Optional comma-separated asset keys (GUIDs) to filter results

params.name: assetName
params.description: Optional partial or full asset name for case-insensitive search

params.name: detailKey
params.description: Optional filter by detail key

params.name: detailName
params.description: Optional filter by detail name (case-insensitive partial match)

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Comma-separated metrics to sort by. Prefix with '+' for ascending (default) or '-' for descending. Example: "applicationObjects,-maxComputeReplicas"

params.name: since
params.description: Start date for usage data (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: to
params.description: End date for usage data (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of asset rows to return. Default: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of asset rows to skip for pagination. Default: 0.

params.name: aggregations
params.description: Optional comma-separated aggregation functions. Valid values: Total, Max, P95, P90

items.docs:
Paginated; supports filtering and sort by metric.

To fetch the usage, API Client needs the **Stage > View stage** and **Subscriptions > View subscription** permissions in the target stage.

info.name: Retrieves information on the entitlements for a specific environment.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Environment key

items.docs:
Entitlements and add-ons are shown with sufficient permissions.

To fetch the entitlements, API Client needs the **Stage > View stage** permission in the target stage.
To additionally fetch the add-ons, API Client also needs the **Subscriptions > View subscription** permission.

info.name: Retrieves usage data for entitlements in a specific environment.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Environment key

params.name: granularity
params.description: Data granularity (summary, hour, day, month). Defaults to summary.

params.name: since
params.description: Start date for usage data (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: to
params.description: End date for usage data (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: entitlementIds
params.description: Optional comma-separated entitlement IDs. Valid values: applicationObjects, maxComputeReplicas, maxDbCompute, maxDbStorage, maxCustomCodeTotalDuration, agentExecutions, internalUsers, externalUsers

params.name: aggregations
params.description: Optional comma-separated aggregation functions. Valid values: Total, Max, P95, P90

params.name: assetKeys
params.description: Optional comma-separated asset keys (GUIDs) to filter results

items.docs:
Filter by entitlement, date range, and aggregation.

To fetch the usage, API Client needs the **Stage > View stage** and **Subscriptions > View subscription** permissions in the target stage.
